# Problem 1

## Data import
```{r}
CPS <- read.table("CPS.dat", header = TRUE)
head(CPS)
```


## (b) & (c)
```{r}
model <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc, data = CPS)
summary(model)
```

## (e)
```{r}
model2 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age, data = CPS)
summary(model2)
```

## (f) Wald test method
```{r}
# H0: beta2 = 0 and beta3 = 0
# H1: At least one coefficient is nonzero

# Estimated coefficients
beta_hat <- coef(model2)

# Variance-covariance matrix
V <- vcov(model2)

# Restriction matrix
R <- rbind(
  c(0, 0, 1, 0),
  c(0, 0, 0, 1)
)

# Wald test statistic
W <- as.numeric(
  t(R %*% beta_hat) %*%
  solve(R %*% V %*% t(R)) %*%
  (R %*% beta_hat)
)

# Degrees of freedom
df <- 2

# P-value
p_value <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Results
W
p_value
```

## (f) F test method
```{r}
model  <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc, data = CPS)
model2 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age, data = CPS)

anova(model, model2)
```

## (g)
```{r}
model2 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age, data = CPS)
summary(model2)
```

## (h)
```{r}
model3 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age + I(age^2), data = CPS)
summary(model3)
```

## (i) F test method
```{r}
model2 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age, data = CPS)
model3 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age + I(age^2), data = CPS)

anova(model2, model3)
```

## (j)
```{r}
model3 <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age + I(age^2), data = CPS)
summary(model3)
```
